title: Replace oversized recommendations with a balanced grid
summary: Two complete products per row on phones, compact imagery and uncluttered pricing.

changes.detail: Removed clipped horizontal carousel, ivory section background and redundant related-card quick-add buttons.
Responsive two-column grid (three on wide screens), smaller image panels, three-line names, quiet brand labels and simple prices.
All recommendation cards fit within the section; product navigation and wishlist controls remain available.
